description: Permanently delete one of your short links: its destination and click history are erased and it stops redirecting. It can't be undone or reactivated, and the code is never given to anyone else. Use it when a destination shouldn't be kept, e.g. a URL with a private token; to just switch a link off, use deactivate_url.

code.description: The link's short code (e.g. AbCdEf, or launch for gajo.io/c/launch). A full short URL also works.

name: delete_url
title: Delete a short link permanently
